seedRules: Select exact finite existing content/index entries only after final package dependency/bundle closure is known. Every copied file must have relative path, SHA256, byte count and mode; preserve identity.
Do not assume all dependency entries must be copied merely because source devDependencies exist. Final archive bundled dependency membership controls actual needs.
No copying a whole home cache, mutable-main dependency symlinks, npm scripts or network fallback.
Separate later grant freezes seed manifest and validates all source bytes before copying to each initially absent task cache. Cache roots are outside original runner lane root set.
Runner environment names the exact task cache; npm may write content/index/tmp/log metadata there. Retain cache and raw install/pack command receipts.
No seed selected, cache inventory scan/copy, metadata write or external allocation in this preparation.
If final package closure proves no preexisting cache entries required, Root must explicitly select and freeze that empty seed relation before launch; it is not inferred here.
cacheFootprintScope: separate from original runner lane footprints; capture logical bytes/allocatedKiB at actual exit under later grant; no guessed counters
